feature_policy: Reuse verified frozen DINOv2 caches; recompute causal differences after temporal edits.
historical_test_policy: R01-R04 have already informed design: diagnostic only, not untouched confirmation.
label_policy: strict-v1: exclude complete mismatched-label videos, never trim or pad.

timing.unknown_fps: Do not convert frames to seconds without evidence.

primary_diagnostic_contrasts: C-00 vs C-01 vs C-02 (same trained model)
C-01 vs C-11 vs C-21 (same location-only inference gate)
confidence.hyperparameter_control: Freeze tracker/theta, pooled/local model and C-00 normal-validation-selected Fourier order/ridge within each fold; refit mean and residual PCA only.
confidence.thresholds: Recalibrate each readout using only reference and threshold splits.

tracker.phase_origin: Anchor coordinates and origin fixed by mapping manual FIT anchors to the shared training template; no equally spaced k/K assumption or test-time warping.
tracker.T1_control: Same causal descriptor including the lag difference as T2; no recursive prior. This isolates filtering, not the existence of all temporal information.
tracker.expansion_rule: If pilot is interpretable, annotate all remaining outer-fold-0 normal-evaluation videos before claiming tracking benefit.

process.speed_stress_normality: Unverified: report stress alarm rate, not industrial normal FPR.
process.state_warmup: Run causally from sequence start; no reset at edit/window onset.
process.AR1: Ridge predictor across two source frames on same normal FIT PCA features; ridge from [0.01,0.1,1] using normal validation error.
process.exclusions: Insufficient prefix/context/window is excluded for every arm; publish counts and reasons.

uncertainty.unit: source recording group when verified, otherwise source file
uncertainty.scope: Descriptive exploratory uncertainty; file bootstrap does not prove recording independence; pilot may be inconclusive.

tracking.uncertainty_policy: A broad paired CI means inconclusive, not success.

confidence.mechanism_check: Gate intervention rescues conditional scores at fixed weights/angle; evaluate fitted-weight effect separately.
confidence.caveat: Historical-test gain is exploratory; no claim of solving calibration solely by meeting relative FPR target.

process.caveat: 5% is a lenient screening ceiling, not desired deployment FPR. All scene values remain visible.

stages.scope: Normal fold audit + R01 calibration diagnosis + 40-video annotation packet
3x3 fit/inference confidence factorial; 3 readouts; same theta
Controlled process deviations, normal speed stress, source-frame-matched stride comparison
Frozen candidate confirmation; no automatic best-test variant selection
